## MKCinema 1.2.1: the TV logo stays put

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV | `MKCinema-TV.apk` | Android TV 7 or later |
| Android phones and tablets | `MKCinema.apk` (the same file) | Android 7 or later |
| LG webOS (beta) | `com.mkcinema.app_1.1.0_all.ipk` | unchanged |
| Windows, macOS, Linux | unchanged from 1.0 | |

1.2.1 installs over 1.2 and keeps your sign-in.

- **Fire TV logo fix:** the MKCinema tile on the Fire TV home screen showed its logo at first, then turned into a grey broken-image tile. The app's icon was an adaptive icon in a mipmap folder, which Fire OS's launcher can't reload for sideloaded apps. The icon and the TV banner are now plain images at every screen density, so the launcher can always find them.

**Fire TV:** in Downloader, enter `mkctv.pages.dev`.
